rating: 4
review_text: I visited Mikee's Seafood during the last week of Mardi Gras while in Gulf Shores and were excited to try such a well-known local spot.

Unfortunately, the service left a lot to be desired. Even the gentleman who seated us had a bit of an attitude, which set the tone for the visit. Our waitress seemed much more attentive and accommodating to other tables, while our party felt largely overlooked throughout the meal. We were never offered a refill on any beverages and she seemed very annoyed.

To be fair, it did appear that the staff may have been overwhelmed due to the busy Mardi Gras week, which we can understand. However, the experience overall just wasn’t very pleasant.

That said, the food itself was actually pretty good and had great flavor. With food like that, the service should really match the quality of the meal so the entire experience feels just as good as the taste.

Everyone’s experience can be different, so I would still encourage others to give them a try and form their own opinion. Hopefully, your visit will come with both great food and great service.

id: 3acdf77d-8760-4d03-a150-35e05f2ea8dd
entity_slug: mikee-s-seafood
reviewer_name: Eunice Watters
rating: 4
body: I visited Mikee's Seafood during the last week of Mardi Gras while in Gulf Shores and were excited to try such a well-known local spot.

Unfortunately, the service left a lot to be desired. Even the gentleman who seated us had a bit of an attitude, which set the tone for the visit. Our waitress seemed much more attentive and accommodating to other tables, while our party felt largely overlooked throughout the meal. We were never offered a refill on any beverages and she seemed very annoyed.

To be fair, it did appear that the staff may have been overwhelmed due to the busy Mardi Gras week, which we can understand. However, the experience overall just wasn’t very pleasant.

That said, the food itself was actually pretty good and had great flavor. With food like that, the service should really match the quality of the meal so the entire experience feels just as good as the taste.

Everyone’s experience can be different, so I would still encourage others to give them a try and form their own opinion. Hopefully, your visit will come with both great food and great service.
